provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/apg-1.mjs. Every binding was checked against the APG page; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

roles.note: All feed content is inside an article.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of the visible label; otherwise aria-label

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of elements inside it that distinguish it

attributes.name: aria-setsize
attributes.values: number loaded, or total; -1 when unknown

attributes.name: aria-busy
attributes.values: true while articles are being added or removed, then false

keyboard.action: Move focus to the next article.
Move focus to the previous article.
Move focus to the first focusable element after the feed (in a nested feed: to the next article of the outer feed).
Move focus to the first focusable element before the feed.

focus.entry: Articles are focusable (tabindex 0 or -1); focus may be on an article or on an element inside it. New articles load as focus approaches the end.
focus.exit: Control+End or Control+Home, since Tab alone could never reach the end of an endless feed.
focus.tabStops: Focusable content of the loaded articles.

keysNotBound.reason: Named only as one option for entering a nested feed; Tab keeps its page-sequence meaning.
An example of a key an author may add for entering a nested feed, not a binding of the pattern.

data.notes: The role has no established keyboard convention; the bindings are a recommendation and need discoverable documentation. Not direction-sensitive.
